citations.claim: Total energy at first violating step exceeds initial 330 J plus tolerance
Rebound speed after floor bounce is larger than pre-impact speed despite e=1
Pre-impact falling speed one step before bounce
Initial mechanical energy of drop from rest

explanation: Single ball dropped from y=11 with dt=1/30, gravity 30, e=1 gains energy at floor bounce: impact speed ~25 becomes rebound ~27.9, raising total energy from ~328 J to ~430 J with zero controller work, exceeding 10%+5J bound. Likely restitution/positional-correction adds energy on deep penetration with large substep count (28-29 substeps at bounce).
vision_note: A single ball falls vertically toward the floor across steps 23 to 25, reaching the floor boundary by step 25. Step 26 shows the ball at the floor at the impact-bounce moment where the energy violation is reported.
